definitions.explanation: The system that provides water to buildings, or the water from it.
The fixture from which water flows.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}の{水|みず}は{飲|の}めます。
examples.english: You can drink the tap water.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}を{止|と}めてください。
{水道代|すいどうだい}が{高|たか}くなりました。
examples.english: The water bill has gone up.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{水道|すいどう}が{止|と}まってしまいました。
examples.english: The water supply was cut off due to the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}から{水|みず}が{出|で}ません。
examples.english: No water is coming out of the tap.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}を{引|ひ}くのに{費用|ひよう}がかかった。
examples.english: It cost money to install the water supply.

examples.japanese: {水道水|すいどうすい}を{直接|ちょくせつ}{飲|の}んでも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
examples.english: It's safe to drink tap water directly.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}の{蛇口|じゃぐち}を{閉|し}めてください。
{水道|すいどう}が{凍|こお}った。
{水道|すいどう}の{水|みず}が{冷|つめ}たい。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{水道|すいどう} combines {水|すい} (water) + {道|どう} (way/path), literally "water way."

COMPOUNDS:
- {水道水|すいどうすい}: tap water
- {水道代|すいどうだい}: water bill
- {水道局|すいどうきょく}: water department/utility
- {水道管|すいどうかん}: water pipe
- {上水道|じょうすいどう}: water supply system
- {下水道|げすいどう}: sewage system

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan is known for having safe, drinkable tap water throughout the country. {水道|すいどう}の{水|みず}は{飲|の}めます (tap water is drinkable) is commonly stated to reassure visitors.
